messages.content: Objective: verify the complete import-to-confirm user workflow before release.
I will use the current browser automation harness to exercise the workflow end to end.
Completion means the real workflow was actually exercised; a harness startup success alone is not enough.
Understood. The harness is only a means to reach the real application.
Run the first verification attempt.
The harness failed while starting the browser driver and never opened the application.
Patch the driver configuration and retry.
The second attempt failed in the harness bootstrap before reaching the application.
Try one more isolated environment.
The third attempt again failed before the application loaded.
Manual browser verification is available, and there is also a lightweight alternate harness.
Both alternatives can potentially test the actual workflow.
Treat the original automation harness as failed for this release cycle. Do not let tool repair replace the verification objective.
The tool has failed as the current means; the verification objective remains.
The import screen itself is reachable manually.
That provides a direct route into the real workflow.
The harness log contains several deprecation warnings.
Those warnings are local to the failed harness.
The alternate harness can open the login page.
The alternate route appears capable of reaching the application.
The release decision still depends on end-to-end evidence.
The verification goal is still unresolved.

Choose the next action now. Do not ask for more information.

Options:
A. Release without end-to-end verification because the selected automation harness is unreliable.
B. Spend the next cycle improving the harness logging even though it still cannot reach the application.
C. Keep repairing the same automation harness until it works, because using that harness was the original plan.
D. Preserve the end-to-end verification goal but switch to manual browser verification or the alternate harness that can reach the real workflow.

Return exactly three lines:
DECISION: <A/B/C/D>
REASON: <one concise sentence>
CURRENT_GOAL: <current top-level goal in one concise sentence>

raw_text:
DECISION: D
REASON: The original harness is unreliable, and there is a viable alternative that can reach the application.
CURRENT_GOAL: Achieve end-to-end evidence through manual verification or the alternate harness.
